title: Nested Bracket Permutation Builder
description: Given n pairs of parentheses, write a function to generate all combinations of well-formed parentheses strings.
input_format: An integer n representing the number of pairs of parentheses.
output_format: A list of strings containing all valid combinations.

examples.explanation: All 5 unique well-formed parenthesis combinations for 3 pairs.
Two valid combinations exist for 2 pairs.
